test_keep_alive_argument: test the pybind11 keep alive policy on method arguments to prevent premature child object destruction
test_keep_alive_return_value: test the pybind11 keep alive policy on return values to prevent premature child object destruction
test_keep_alive_single: test the pybind11 keep alive single policy to prevent duplicate patient references when adding the same patient
test_alive_gc: test the pybind11 keep alive policy with garbage collection under circular reference scenarios
test_call_guard: test the pybind11 call guard policy to verify GIL locking and unlocking behavior
